summary: Daily Journal Corporation filed an 8-K on October 15, 2026, reporting completion on October 13, 2026 of its acquisition of Austin, Texas-based Revir Technologies, Inc., whose AI-driven Scout platform helps law enforcement, prosecutors and corrections agencies manage, search and analyze large digital evidence collections. The deal was structured as a merger of a wholly owned Daily Journal subsidiary into Revir, funded with cash on hand; Revir will operate independently within Daily Journal's Courts, Justice, and Government Technology division alongside Journal Technologies, Inc. No price, share count or premium was disclosed, and the company stated the acquisition is not material to it.
